verdict.rationale: The docs only hint at no-cost entry points. Billing mentions "included credits" with metered usage beyond them. A basic readiness scan runs against any MCP URL without signing in, and the CLI supports local development with hot reload and an inspector. A community user, however, found the credit system unclear and could not budget for costs beyond plan limits. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented free tier, its limits and credit amounts, confirmation that prototyping tool connections is covered at no cost, and independent confirmation that the free allowance is meaningful.
